title: ingestion_run
description: Coverage / provenance of each raw pull — makes ingest completeness a queryable fact (sov denominator trust). The structured form of `wsb heartbeat` + the [CAP] pagination canary. Append-only metadata, not regenerable. See data-dictionary.md §7.5 and data-model.md §5.2.
x-grain: one ingestion pass per (source, kind) at a poll time

source.description: The tap pulled (arctic_shift is the sole live Reddit tap in v0.0.1).

kind.description: What was pulled. Superset of ContentKind (adds `market` for market-data pulls).

cursor.description: Pagination / since token carried forward to the next pull.

oldest_item.description: Event time of the oldest item fetched this pull.

newest_item.description: Event time of the newest item fetched this pull.

capped.description: Hit the pagination cap ⇒ the window may be incomplete ⇒ its sov denominator is untrustworthy (data-model invariant 14).

lag_seconds.description: Newest item vs wall clock — the freshness/staleness measure (alarms above heartbeat.max_staleness_seconds).

status.description: Heartbeat verdict (mirrors `wsb heartbeat` exit codes: ok / stale / tap down).
